transcript: Never ever eat these three things. In the morning, if you want more energy, better digestion and a clearer mind. My friend, the morning is when your body is most sensitive. What you consume in the first hour can influence your energy, focus, digestion and metabolism for the rest of the day. Number one. Coffee on an empty stomach. Many people wake up and immediately reach for coffee. But coffee on an empty stomach can increase stress hormones, irritate digestion and often leave you feeling drained later in the day. Start with warm water. Let your body wake up first. Then enjoy your coffee after food. Number two. Sugary breakfasts and refined carbohydrates. Pastries, sugary cereals, sweetened yogurts. These foods create a rapid spike in blood sugar followed by a crash, leaving you tired, mentally foggy and craving more sugar just a few hours later. Number three. Very cold foods and drinks. Ice cold smoothies, cold yogurt drinks. These can slow digestion and leave you feeling heavy instead of energized. Remember this, my friend. The morning sets the tone for the entire day. Begin your day with warm, balanced nutrition and your body will thank you. And if you're struggling with bloating, constipation or poor digestion, one of the easiest things you can do is increase your daily fiber intake. The fiber I personally recommend is physicians choice. You can find it in the link in my profile or on Amazon. Comment morning below if you've been guilty of any of these habits and follow for more health wisdom.
